name: build-jam
description: The build-make fixture, built with jam(1) — the native Haiku build tool — so the shell/build category is exercised with the toolchain haikode actually ships next to.
proves: the same build round trip as build-make, but against jam, whose diagnostics and output layout differ from make's. Requires jam on PATH; the harness reports it as unavailable rather than as a failure when jam is missing.
notes: Not verified on macOS: jam is not installed there. On Haiku, `pkgman install jam`.
prompt:
This C project does not build. Run `jam`, read the compiler error, and fix the source so the build succeeds. Then run `./app` and check the output.

`./app` must print exactly `clamped=7`. Do not edit the Jamfile and do not change `src/util.c` or `src/util.h` — the bug is on the calling side.

pre_checks.label: the jam build fails before the agent runs
the seeded call site is present

checks.label: nothing outside the project was touched
